                                     [--fee AMOUNT] [--fee-pct PCT] [--warmup]
                                     [--json] [--csv OUT]
                                     csv_path

Walk-forward test of the SMA crossover: pick the best window pair on each
train block, then run it on the test block that follows.

positional arguments:
  csv_path       CSV file with a 'close' column

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --short LIST   short windows, e.g. 5,10,20
  --long LIST    long windows, e.g. 20,50,100
  --train N      bars in each train block
  --test N       bars in each test block
  --step N       bars each window moves on (default: --test)
  --cash AMOUNT  starting cash (default: 10,000)
  --fee AMOUNT   fixed cost per trade (default: 0)
  --fee-pct PCT  percent of traded value per trade (default: 0)
  --warmup       warm the moving averages up on the chosen pair's long bars
                 before each test block (trades and scores still only inside
                 the test block)
  --json         print one JSON object with the windows and the summary
                 instead of text
  --csv OUT      also write one row per window to OUT as CSV

Research aid only. Not financial advice.

usage: trading_assistant.walkforward [-h] --short LIST --long LIST --train N

                                     [--fee AMOUNT] [--fee-pct PCT] [--warmup]
                                     [--json] [--csv OUT]

Walk-forward test of the SMA crossover: pick the best window pair on each
train block, then run it on the test block that follows.

positional arguments:
  csv_path       CSV file with a 'close' column

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --short LIST   short windows, e.g. 5,10,20
  --long LIST    long windows, e.g. 20,50,100
  --train N      bars in each train block
  --test N       bars in each test block
  --step N       bars each window moves on (default: --test)
  --cash AMOUNT  starting cash (default: 10,000)
  --fee AMOUNT   fixed cost per trade (default: 0)
  --fee-pct PCT  percent of traded value per trade (default: 0)
  --warmup       warm the moving averages up on the chosen pair's long bars
                 before each test block (trades and scores still only inside
                 the test block)
  --json         print one JSON object with the windows and the summary
                 instead of text
  --csv OUT      also write one row per window to OUT as CSV

Research aid only. Not financial advice.
